metadata.quantity_basis: 15 BC clamps plus16 NT clamp screws; coupon/test spares additional
metadata.custom_items: BB1..7, NB1..8,23 Cu contact shims and8 separate Cu branch backing washers are manufactured to the companion drawings, not unselected COTS parts.

items.description: M3x12 full-thread stainlessA2 socket screw, DIN912/ISO4762, precote80 locking coating
items.notes: Single-use locking coating; replace after removal. Locking-coating torque is not used to infer clamp force. No washer under head atNT screws; washer under head atBC screws.

items.description: M3 DIN7349 heavy flat washer, stainlessA4 black finish;15topBC+31bottomspringseats
items.notes: Supports8mm disc spring; steel washer is not credited as current path. No teeth againstPCB.

items.description: Disc spring DSC8x3.2x0.3BR; three nested same-direction springs per clamp
items.notes: High-carbon steel, phosphate/oil. Nested-stack friction, load spread, coating and copper/FR4 creep require coupon confirmation. Do not equate catalogue nominal312N to measuredforce.

items.description: KaptonHN polyimide film50um,500x500mm sheet;cut four continuous layers perbar
items.notes: Incoming four-layer stack must be<=0.22mm to maintain contact shim protrusion. This is a stricter assembly acceptance than catalogue nominal; oversizefilm is rejected, not silently compensated by torque. One500mmsheet supplies thecutpieces; no within-bar seams.

coupon_release.instructions: Use samePCBthickness/finish,Cushim,film,bar,screw,springs,andnut asassembly. Measure actualstackforce at0.1875mm compression; verify noPCBindentation/cracks or film cutting after10cycles. Cool, checkforce and fourwireresistance. Prototypeenergization requires acceptedcoupons; no testhasbeenperformed.
